bio: At this restaurant in a beautiful historical house on the road leading to the imposing Basilika Rankweil, the culinary focus is firmly on the region. The young chef serves dinner surprise set menus only. Fresh, seasonal ingredients go into preparing five, seven or nine courses, all of which demonstrate a personal touch. As an alternative to the Tellerservice menu, there is also the option of the Meal Sharing menu. The service is extremely friendly and, with its blend of traditional style shown off by modern accents, the interior is charming....
